name: clip
summary: 13 key moments: ready -> right foot forward -> right kneeling lunge -> standing rise -> feet together stance -> left knee lifted -> left foot forward -> left kneeling lunge -> standing rise -> feet together stance -> right foot forward -> right kneeling lunge -> standing rise -> neutral standing (finish)
action: The body alternates stepping forward into a deep kneeling lunge on each side and rising back to standing.

stages.name: right foot forward
stages.description: The body steps the right foot forward and outward from standing.
stages.measured: right foot right, right foot forward

stages.name: right kneeling lunge
stages.description: The body sinks into a crouch with the right knee bent forward and the left knee on the floor.

stages.name: standing rise
stages.description: The body rises up from the kneel to a standing position.

stages.name: feet together stance
stages.description: The body draws the right foot back and plants the left foot down.
stages.measured: right foot back, left foot down

stages.name: left knee lifted
stages.description: The body turns right and lifts the left foot with the knee bent.

stages.name: left foot forward
stages.description: The body lowers the left foot down to land forward of the body.
stages.measured: left foot down, left foot forward

stages.name: left kneeling lunge
stages.description: The body sinks into a crouch with the left knee bent forward and the opposite knee down.

stages.name: standing rise
stages.description: The body rises up from the kneel to standing.

stages.name: feet together stance
stages.description: The body draws the left foot back to plant both feet under the hips.
stages.measured: left foot back, left foot down

stages.name: right foot forward
stages.description: The body turns left and extends the right foot forward.

stages.name: right kneeling lunge
stages.description: The body sinks into a crouch with the front knee bent and the back knee on the floor.

stages.name: standing rise
stages.description: The body rises up from the kneel to standing.

stages.name: neutral standing (finish)
stages.description: The body settles to a neutral stance with the right foot in and arms at the sides.
stages.measured: right foot left, left hand left (finish)

notes: Progress toward the next key moment pays as it happens, gated on staying upright.
Each key moment reached pays a bonus; a jump pays extra for its height.
Finishing pays a bonus scaled by the moments reached.
Once done, holding the end pose pays per second, and the style terms stop.
A fall gives back what the attempt earned since the last steady stance.
Timing is free: only the order of the moments counts.
Optional moments pay too, but may be skipped.
